list: Official 55 trophies as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden. Names and descriptions are shown as PlayStation publishes them. Guides are written for this entry in our own words, with the source of each fact named beside it.
sources_note: Guides draw on PowerPyx (GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap), GTABase, and the cross-checked lists at Of Zen and Computing, Output Lag, GTA Zone, GTA Vice City Hub, KeenGamer, Leonida Intel, Insider Gaming and EGamers. Where no guide has confirmed a method yet, the guide says so instead of guessing.

roadmap.title: Play the story, Chapters 1 to 5
roadmap.text: Finish the campaign first. The chapter trophies, the named-mission trophies and the vague story trophies all land here, and nothing in the story can be missed except one thing: Lucia's Chapter 1 balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter, since there is no mission replay. PowerPyx roadmap, Step 1.

roadmap.title: Side-character finales
roadmap.text: Finish the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, plus Bret's unique-animal hunt. Every one of these questlines stays available after the story in free-roam, so none of them can be missed. PowerPyx roadmap, Step 1.

roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks: 8 strands
roadmap.text: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only certain questlines count, including Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete. They all stay available after the story. PowerPyx, Strangers & Freaks.

roadmap.title: Explore Leonida
roadmap.text: Unfog the whole map, meditate at every spot, scan 100 WAiNK locations and discover 100 vehicles. Do the scanning as you travel and it finishes itself. PowerPyx, The Goodtime State / You WAiNKer! / Whip It Good.

roadmap.title: Races, stunts, shooting range, arcade
roadmap.text: Win 20 different races, a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations, land 250 stunts, gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges, finish an arcade game and try all 9 activity types. For 100% completion you need 300 stunts and 70 of 80 challenges, so aim past the trophy numbers. PowerPyx, Step 2.

roadmap.title: Robberies
roadmap.text: Rob 5 bank vaults, an armored truck, a jewelry store unseen, 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs, and steal the 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling. Bank vaults unlock from the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is. PowerPyx, Maximum Withdrawal / A Classic Blitz Play.

roadmap.title: Collectibles, money and garages
roadmap.text: Complete 3 collectible card sets, buy all 8 purchasable garages, register 10 vehicles with the Scooter Bros app, spend $100,000 across shops and launder $250,000 in Marked Bills. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each and fund all of it. PowerPyx, Little Boxes / Dime on the Dollar.

roadmap.title: Cleanup, then 100% completion
roadmap.text: Finish any 50 challenges, push your criminal profile to 500 actions, mop up the unconfirmed one-off trophies, then complete the 100% checklist under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. A Long Road pops, and Vice Got a Price! follows at once. PowerPyx roadmap, Steps 2 and 3.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing to do for it directly. In practice it lands right after A Long Road, the gold for 100% completion, since that is the last trophy most players earn. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 in difficulty and about 200 hours, with one playthrough enough and no online trophies.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1. Just play the opening mission through to its end and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish Chapter 1, which PowerPyx says happens after completing the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag? Play the story in order and it comes on its own.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish Chapter 2, which PowerPyx says happens after the first main mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City. Keep playing the main missions and it pops at the chapter break.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish Chapter 3, which PowerPyx says happens after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. No side content is needed for it.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish Chapter 4, which PowerPyx says happens after the final main mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero. Play the chapter's main missions to the end.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish the final mission of the game, in Chapter 5. PowerPyx lists it as one of the two gold trophies, alongside A Long Road, and notes there is no mission replay, so keep a manual save before the final mission in case you want to revisit anything.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. Play that mission through and the trophy pops when it ends.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. Finish the heist mission and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. Complete the mission and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. Finish the mission and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. Complete the mission and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. Finish the mission and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the last one most players earn. The 100% checklist unlocks after the story under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, but progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on it is missable. The requirements are lenient, closer to 60% true completion: any 100 optional missions (there are 200-300+), any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, any 100 of 255 animals studied with binoculars, 300 stunts, any 70 of 80 challenges, and all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Do side content as it appears and clean up the rest in free-roam after the story.

sources.name: GTA Zone — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida. There are 4 kinds: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Mix the kinds freely and pick the quickest; PowerPyx says under-the-bridge flights are the fastest. Track progress by region under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots. Note that 100% completion needs 300 stunts, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your count under Touchpad, Progress, Activities. PowerPyx says you will do one of each automatically while working on the other trophies, so this one should take care of itself.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 shooting range locations. PowerPyx links a full location guide for all 12 ranges; the medals are not too hard, and 100% completion also needs all of them. Work through the ranges one by one after the story.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations, 42 drone races in total across them. PowerPyx links a guide to all 14 locations. Winning one race at each location is enough for the trophy, but 100% completion needs all the drone races, so keep racing after it pops.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The same race won twice does not count twice, so work through the 40 unique race locations PowerPyx lists and win a fresh one each time. Race challenges and Top Fun drone races also count toward the activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing location with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline and out-fish him in the challenge he sets.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the 4 arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable at the TV in your home from Chapter 1, using the controllers, and the fourth is on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end once; beating every challenge inside a game is not required.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's 5-quest optional line, which is exclusive to Lucia. It is marked automatically in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. The quests are Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All of them stay available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving line. It is marked automatically in Chapter 1, a while after the mission Island Dreams where you work for him; he calls you and is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. He marks purple treasure chest icons on the map: find the underwater treasures from 7 shipwrecks with the metal detector and bring them back. Kenton becomes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapter 2-3, and as Jason you can speed it up by calling Brian. Track it under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's 5-quest optional line. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. The quests are Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All of them stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers. Only certain questlines count; the big optional lines for Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy. Confirmed counting strands include Kirk (Skunk Ape / Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries), with more still being found. All strangers stay available after the story, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows your count.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List: deliver 16 sports cars he wants. The line is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. Track the cars under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List; he marks some in fixed locations, but you can steal them anywhere off the street, and scanning a car with the WAiNK app tells you if it is on the list. Deliver each car to his garage in the west of Vice City, in good condition for more pay. The 16 cars include the Zorrusso, Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee and Baller ST-D. It can all be done after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's line, which is only available as Jason. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City, and you destroy them in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. After enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives his second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down, and finishing it pops the trophy. All of it stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: POTENTIALLY MISSABLE: the first meditation, Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house, can only be done in Chapter 1 and is gone after that chapter. It is unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy, so do it to be safe.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. You can meditate with both Lucia and Jason at each spot, which counts as +2 at the same location, and you cannot do the final one until both characters can play together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Track them under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. THE WARNING: after the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow her and choose Accept. That meditation adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a Meditation Spot, so it is unclear whether the trophy needs it. PowerPyx's author had done it when the trophy popped, so do it in Chapter 1 to be safe. For 100% completion only 15 of 18 meditations are needed.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. His line is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret that marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. It is exclusive to Jason. After that he marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. During the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. Track the hunts under Map, Activities, Target Deck; all 15 Target Decks are needed for 100% completion. Which animal exactly pops the trophy is still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. PowerPyx links a guide to all 18 card set locations. Cards are a pure collectible hunt: find the sets in the world and complete three of them. You do not need every set for this trophy.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app: hold Up on the D-pad and then R1 while looking at a scannable object. There are far more than 100, and any 100 count: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags. Scan whatever you pass while travelling and the trophy finishes itself.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. For 100% completion you need any 70 of 80, so this trophy pops on the way there. View and track challenges under Progress, Challenges. Many complete naturally while you work on the other trophies, so leave this for late, then pick the easiest and quickest of the ones you have left.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, reach a 4-star wanted level and then escape the red heat zone. You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together; call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Build 4 stars by causing carnage, then escape on a fast sports motorcycle, cutting through traffic. PowerPyx's easiest route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops struggle to follow and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops after you drive out of the red heat zone. It also comes automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, since bank vault robberies always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row while keeping your wanted level the whole time. Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Hit robbery targets marked with green icons, keep the red and blue flashing wanted level alive (not the red heat level), and loot a few items in each shop, ideally breaking the safe with sticky bombs in the back room. Equip an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, and carry Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. The trophy pops about half a minute after leaving the third shop; if it does not, hit a fourth shop and keep going. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The game has 557 vehicles at launch, and the quickest way is the WAiNK app on your phone: hold Up to open it instantly, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. Just stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by; you only need to scan a vehicle, not drive it. Check your totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles. You need 200 of the 277 base models scanned for 100% completion, so this trophy pops on the way.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies inside one use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar. First buff your focus with food or drinks, or by washing your face or showering at home, and take Adrenaline to extend the window (hold L1, then Triangle). Then line up 5 enemies, for example criminals at a gang operation, and drop them quickly without missing. Use an assault rifle like the Duke 556 for accuracy and full-auto fire, wear body armor from Ammu-Nation, and get close. PowerPyx notes it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting range challenges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots; by the time you reach Focus level 4 this gets much easier.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked to a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) and fly away. It must be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not one sitting on the airfield. The easiest is the plane at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, and use the stairs by the boarding bridge with the door leading straight inside. Go upstairs into the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off, and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport; the trophy pops a little after takeoff. You can also enter through the terminal on foot, but the airfield route is faster.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank, a Rhino. They stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons on the map. Break in through the back door using the Snap Gun (the prompt offers kicking the door, which triggers the alarm, or the Snap Gun for the stealth approach), go to the back room, find the note with the safe code, and loot the safe. A good location is Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (Wait at the Cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress and teaches the method: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, watch a guard carry a briefcase of cash in and open the vault, then slip in while it is open and rob it, bringing your partner and handing off a bag with Right on the D-pad since you cannot carry all the cash alone. After that, pay Yasmani, the fence from Chapter 3, $10,000 for tips about security vans, marked with purple icons. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. For 100% completion you need all 8 vaults, and each pays up to $205,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the red heat radius. The trophy comes automatically from the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, the same mission that unlocks bank vault robberies: tailing the armored truck to the bank and robbing its vault counts as robbing an armored truck. For an earlier method, find armored trucks driving around Vice City near banks, block their path, plant a sticky bomb on the back door and blow it open, then escape the heat radius or use a Pay 'n' Spray. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests; Yasmani becomes a fence automatically from the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible. PowerPyx links a guide to the best plane for unfogging the map quickly.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total; for this trophy one per gang is enough, but 100% completion needs all 39. They are marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track your count per gang under Progress, Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch: no guide has pinned down the exact trigger yet. The description says to enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so the likely method is ordering a cocktail at a bar or venue overlooking Ocean Beach, but PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, and other lists agree the method is not confirmed. Do not chase a specific spot on guesswork; check the PowerPyx guide for updates as players confirm it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch: no guide has pinned down the exact trigger yet. The description points to smashing your way out of a vehicle showroom, in the style of the classic GTA showroom escape, but PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown. Check the PowerPyx guide for updates as players confirm the showroom and the method.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. It is marked automatically during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Before you go, buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation; you need them to destroy the safe. Inside the alley, pick up the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and loot the safe in the north-east hallway by blowing it up with sticky bombs. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. If you miss an item during the mission, wait for the robbery icon to respawn and go back for what is left; it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Check strength under Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, then the Strength entry with the heart icon. Raise strength by working out; buy a membership at a fitness club and always go together with both characters (hold Right and press Triangle to call your partner), because while one works out the other completes their training too, doubling progress. Fitness clubs are listed under Map, Activities, with the dumbbell icon, and you can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. The trophy list itself tracks your count out of 500. Turn on criminal profile notifications under Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile, and a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action counts. Actions fall into five profiles: Professional (stealthy objectives and robberies, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating enemies without killing them), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, or driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable, a permanent status from excessive violence that makes cops more aggressive, so avoid it. It should come passively from robberies and fights across the other trophies; if it is the last one left, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch: no guide has pinned down the exact trigger yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, and the description, Second time's the charm, suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something. Do not chase a specific method on guesswork; check the PowerPyx guide for updates as players confirm it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch: no guide has pinned down the exact trigger yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to come from a UFO questline, and the description, What the hell just happened?, points to a strange encounter rather than a repeatable activity. Check the PowerPyx guide for updates as players confirm the questline.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch: no guide has pinned down the exact trigger yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to come from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle, a melee drive-by. The name plays on bowling, so the likely method is knocking enemies down with melee attacks from a moving bike. Check the PowerPyx guide for updates as players confirm it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check, where you meet Raul's crew, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total counts across all robberies, not in one trip, and it comes naturally while doing the robberies for 100% completion. Bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 each, but they only unlock after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops. The total is cumulative across every shop kind. The fastest way is the most expensive goods: guns at the 24 Ammu-Nations, car mods at the 14 mod shops, and tattoos at the 11 tattoo studios, plus clothing at 67 stores, footwear, hair and beauty salons, electronics stores and Pay 'n' Sprays. It should pop naturally while gearing up for the other trophies.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages; the 4 story-related garages do not count. They cost about $160,000 in total. Garages become available after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver, where you steal the Crawler for Moses, and you buy them through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone. Robberies, especially the bank vaults in Chapters 3 and 4, are the quickest way to fund them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses, where you take a vehicle to Moses, and it lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere. Buy enough garages first, since each garage adds parking spots to register more vehicles. Then drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, and in his garage choose Respray and then Register. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
